content.short: Centrifuge is a decentralized asset financing protocol that tokenizes real-world assets for DeFi liquidity.
content.description: Centrifuge is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol that bridges the gap between real-world assets (RWAs) and the digital asset ecosystem. By enabling businesses to tokenize non-crypto assets such as invoices, real estate, and royalties, Centrifuge allows them to access low-cost financing directly from DeFi investors. These tokenized assets are used as collateral in the protocol's Tinlake pools, where users can provide liquidity and earn stable, asset-backed yields. Built on its own Polkadot-based blockchain and deeply integrated with Ethereum, Centrifuge provides a transparent and efficient marketplace for credit, fostering a more inclusive and resilient global financial system.
content.meta: Centrifuge tokenizes real-world assets for decentralized financing, enabling businesses to access DeFi liquidity and investors to earn asset-backed yields.
